## MOMETAMAX^{®} Otic Suspension

(Gentamicin Sulfate, Mometasone Furoate Monohydrate, and Clotrimazole, Otic Suspension)

Product Description

Reliable relief of discomfort and irritation for mild to moderate cases

A convenient once-daily, triple-combination treatment applied for 7 days for mild to moderate cases of otitis externa associated with susceptible strains of yeast and bacteria in dogs.

PRODUCT LABEL

Overview

Technical

### Indications

MOMETAMAX^{®} Otic Suspension is indicated for the treatment of otitis externa in dogs caused by susceptible strains of yeast (Malassezia pachydermatis) and bacteria (Pseudomonas spp. [including P. aeruginosa], coagulase-positive staphylococci, Enterococcus faecalis, Proteus mirabilis, and beta-hemolytic streptococci).

### Features and Benefits

### ANTI-INFLAMMATORY ACTION

MOMETASONE FUROATE MONOHYDRATE
Reduces discomfort, redness and swelling^{1}

Mometasone rapidly controls inflammation without adrenocortical suppression^{2}

### ANTIFUNGAL ACTIVITY

CLOTRIMAZOLE
Effective against dermal infections caused by susceptible strains of yeast (Malassezia pachydermatis)^{1}

### ANTIBACTERIAL EFFECT

GENTAMICIN
Effective against a wide variety of Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria^{1}

### Diseases/Parasites

Canine otitis externa
